config.title: SystemVerilog Tools
cfg.oneBindPerLine.desc: One port binding per line in module instance
cfg.paramOneLine.desc: Keep parameters on one line if possible
cfg.stripEmptyLine.desc: Strip empty lines introduced when aligning port/parameter lists
cfg.maxConsecutiveEmptyLines.desc: Maximum consecutive empty lines allowed (0 = keep none where allowed, -1 = leave blank lines untouched)
cfg.importSameLine.desc: Keep import on same line as module declaration
cfg.inlineCompact.desc: Inline compact: collapse extra spaces within single-line statements (keywords, variables, operators; e.g. else $error("x", $time))
cfg.blankCompact.desc: Interline compact: actively remove extra blank lines (removed inside blocks, folded between blocks). Off: keep user blank lines and never add new ones
cfg.portNameGap.desc: Gap (spaces) between the widest direction/type/range prefix and the name column in module/interface port lists and task/function parameter lists (1-8)
cfg.instPrefix.desc: Default prefix for module instance name
cfg.includePortDeclarations.desc: Include signal declarations when generating module instantiation (input->reg, output->wire)
cfg.waveType.desc: Waveform format for generated testbenches (VCD by default; FSDB/VPD/SHM require a compatible simulator).
cfg.headerTemplate.desc: Multiline header template with {FILE}, {DATE}, {TIME} and {YEAR} placeholders. Paste real line breaks here; settings.json uses JSON \n escapes. Empty uses the built-in template. headerTemplateFile takes precedence.
cfg.headerTemplateFile.desc: UTF-8 header template file, read on every insertion. Supports an absolute path, a path relative to the current document's workspace folder, or ${workspaceFolder}/templates/header.txt. Outside a workspace, relative paths use the source file directory. Empty uses headerTemplate. Invalid files report an error without inserting a fallback.
cfg.lintEngine.desc: Lint engine: Icarus Verilog (iverilog -tnull) or Vivado xvlog (uses svtools.vivado.path for toolchain lookup)
cfg.lintEngine.xvlog: Vivado xvlog — Vivado syntax check, same diagnostics as xsim compile step
cfg.iverilog_path.desc: Icarus Verilog bin directory (or full path to iverilog executable). Empty = auto-detect from IVERILOG_HOME, PATH and common install locations.
cfg.iverilog_cygwinPath.desc: Directory containing cygwin1.dll, required by Cygwin builds of Icarus Verilog installed outside a Cygwin root. Empty = auto-detect.
cfg.iverilog_lintOnSave.desc: Run iverilog syntax check on save and report diagnostics in the Problems panel
cfg.iverilog_scanWorkspace.desc: Scan the workspace for Verilog sources: add every directory containing them to -y/-I, and resolve missing modules by indexing module definitions (handles files whose name differs from the module name)
cfg.iverilog_lintOnChange.desc: Run iverilog syntax check while typing (debounced, lints the unsaved buffer via a temp file)
cfg.iverilog_lintDebounceMs.desc: Debounce delay in milliseconds for lint-on-type
cfg.iverilog_lintOnOpen.desc: Run iverilog syntax check when a Verilog file is opened
cfg.iverilog_standard.desc: Language standard passed as -g. auto: .sv/.svh use 2012, .v/.vh use 2005; default: let iverilog decide
cfg.iverilog_lintArgs.desc: Extra iverilog arguments for lint and simulation compile (e.g. -Wall)
cfg.iverilog_includePaths.desc: Include directories (-I), relative to the workspace root. The file's own directory is always included.
cfg.iverilog_libraryPaths.desc: Library directories (-y) for module-by-filename resolution, relative to the workspace root. The file's own directory is always included.
cfg.iverilog_simFiles.desc: Glob patterns of extra source files compiled together with the active file during simulation (e.g. src/*.v, tb/*.sv)
cfg.iverilog_simTop.desc: Top module for simulation (-s). Empty = let iverilog pick the root module
cfg.iverilog_simArgs.desc: Simulation extended arguments after the .vvp input file (e.g. +trace, +seed=73, -fst). Known vvp CLI options (-l/-M/-m with values and -h/-i/-n/-N/-q/-s/-v/-V) remain before the file; use -- to pass subsequent values as extended arguments.
cfg.iverilog_simTimeoutMs.desc: Simulation timeout in milliseconds; 0 = run until $finish (stop via command or status bar)
cfg.iverilog_waveViewer.desc: External waveform viewer executable (e.g. GTKWave). Empty = use the built-in VCD waveform viewer (webview panel; external program is used for .fst files)
cfg.iverilog_autoOpenWaveform.desc: Automatically open the built-in waveform viewer when a simulation produces a new .vcd file

cfg.vivado_path.desc: Vivado installation directory (e.g. D:/Xilinx/Vivado/2022.1, its bin directory, or full path to vivado.bat). Empty = auto-detect from XILINX_VIVADO, PATH and common install locations.
cfg.vivado_part.desc: Default FPGA part for the project creation wizard (-part, e.g. xc7a35tcsg324-1). Leave empty to choose later in Vivado.
cfg.vivado_projectDir.desc: Default project output directory (relative to workspace root) used by the project creation wizard
cfg.vivado_timeoutMs.desc: Vivado batch timeout in milliseconds; 0 = no timeout (stop via command or status bar)
cfg.vivado_structure.desc: Project structure template used by the project creation wizard: directory globs that classify files into sources / sim / constraints filesets, and the Vivado project output directory. Defaults follow the common src/sim/prj layout.
cfg.vivado_structure_sources.desc: Globs for RTL source files added to fileset sources_1 (e.g. src, rtl/**)
cfg.vivado_structure_sim.desc: Globs for testbench files added to fileset sim_1 (e.g. sim, tb/**); takes precedence over sources
cfg.vivado_structure_constraints.desc: Globs for constraint files added to fileset constrs_1 (e.g. xdc/**, *.xdc)
cfg.vivado_structure_projectDir.desc: Vivado project output directory relative to the workspace root (e.g. prj)

cfg.tasksRetainedRuns.desc: Keep at most this many recent task directories per kind under .svtools (stage logs and run artifacts); older ones are deleted automatically after a task finishes. 0 = never delete

cfg.completion_uvmVersion.desc: UVM completion API profile: UVM 1.2, IEEE 1800.2-2020 (Accellera 2020.3.2), or disabled. Does not change compiler settings.
cfg.completion_includePaths.desc: Additional HDL include/library directories for completion indexing. Relative paths resolve from each workspace folder; supports ${workspaceFolder}.
cfg.completion_maxFiles.desc: Maximum HDL files indexed for completion. Exceeding the budget returns an incomplete completion list.
cfg.completion_maxFileSizeKB.desc: Maximum size of a closed HDL source indexed for completion, in KiB. Open documents use their current unsaved buffer.
cfg.completion_maxTotalSourceMB.desc: Total UTF-8 source budget for closed-document completion indexing, in MiB. This is a source budget, not a heap memory limit.
cfg.completion_standard.desc: Completion keyword standard. Auto uses the document language and active `begin_keywords directive. This setting does not change compiler options.
cfg.completion_maxItems.desc: Maximum items per completion request. Broad requests are marked incomplete; keep typing to narrow candidates without losing indexed declarations.

cfg.circuit.yosysPath: Use bundled for the included offline Yosys WASM engine; no Python or separate tool installation is required. Alternatively specify a local Yosys executable.
cfg.circuit.frontend: auto uses Slang with bundled Yosys and read_verilog -sv with external tools. slang/verilog explicitly override the choice; external slang requires read_slang support.
cfg.circuit.sources: Ordered RTL source files. Empty: discover module/interface/package dependencies within the current workspace folder. Non-empty: use this exact order, then append the current file if missing; no automatic discovery.
cfg.circuit.includeDirs: Local HDL include directories, relative to the workspace folder or absolute.
cfg.circuit.defines: Preprocessor definitions such as SYNTHESIS or WIDTH=8.
cfg.circuit.top: Top module for RTL circuit generation. Leave empty to choose from the active file.
cfg.circuit.generationTimeout: Maximum circuit generation time in seconds.

cfg.project.traceTrigger.desc: Choose when project signal tracing runs. Also available in the project actions menu.
cfg.project.traceTrigger.selection: Trace a selected signal automatically after a short delay.
cfg.project.traceTrigger.manual: Trace only through the editor context menu or project command.
